plotEn:
The story unfolds in 1908 in Saint Petersburg, Russian Empire. Andrei Nagel, editor-in-chief of Automobile magazine, meets Dmitri Bondarev, a talented engineer. Together they come up with an ambitious idea — to create the first domestic production car at the Russo-Baltic Wagon Factory in Riga.
The project is facing serious skepticism from officials and investors. To prove the car's competitiveness to the whole world and save production from closure, Nagel and Bondarev decide to take a risky step — to take part in the prestigious Monaco International Rally, which runs through Europe in harsh winter conditions.
